name: ForIT Dictate
textScreensWhy: The app keeps no text the person wrote: the keyboard types a dictation into whichever app is open, and the trial text on the home screen is shown once, read only, and not kept.

signIn.none: The first cut calls no ForIT service: speech is the operating system's, on the device. Sign-in arrives with the company dictionary (task A8482CC9).

offline.why: Dictation is recorded and transcribed on the device by the operating system's speech. The app calls no ForIT service and keeps no history: a recording is deleted once it is text, and the text waits in the app group only until the keyboard types it.

waivers.FB-1: Feedback needs a signed-in sender and this cut has no sign-in; it is wired in the build that adds sign-in (task A8482CC9).
waivers.OF-1: The app has no server data to load, cache or sync, so none of the three modes describes it; revisit when the company dictionary gives it server data.
waivers.PL-2..5: The Mac build of ForIT Dictate is the app in this repository's VoiceInk.xcodeproj, shipped outside the App Store with the same bundle id; Apple Vision is not built until the iPhone keyboard is proven on Ben's phones (task A8482CC9).
